core_thesis.statement: Messaging is not a single piece of content; it is experienced over time across multiple pieces.
core_thesis.implication: Over-polishing one video, podcast or page before publishing anything is wasted effort, because one piece alone can't deliver your messaging.

element_categories.invisible_elements: Foundations the audience won't see directly but will experience
element_categories.visible_content: Content the audience directly sees and interacts with
element_categories.results_and_outcomes: What the audience and the world gain

invisible_elements.name: Struggle Avatar (SA)
invisible_elements.definition: An identity created within your brand that the audience adopts and uses to describe themselves.

invisible_elements.name: Future Paced Hero (FPH)
invisible_elements.definition: The identity the audience aspires to become, creating internal desire.

invisible_elements.name: Unique Solution
invisible_elements.definition: Your proprietary solution that bridges the gap from SA to FPH.

invisible_elements.name: Specifics & Common Enemy
invisible_elements.definition: The exact actions, pains, mistakes, emotions and feelings of the SA, plus a shared enemy.
why_it_works: Deep specifics signal to the subconscious 'this is about me', pulling people in and driving conversion
A common enemy unites the audience and deepens their connection to you

invisible_elements.name: Desires
invisible_elements.definition: The specific feelings, tangible results and experiences of the FPH, used to create demand.

invisible_elements.name: Deeper Purpose
invisible_elements.definition: Why you do what you do; the bigger change that happens when many people (e.g. 10,000) get your promised result. Not the direct result itself.

visible_content_types.name: Deeper Purpose Connection Content
visible_content_types.purpose: Shares your mission so the SA feels part of it — builds a movement or community.

visible_content_types.name: Connection Content
visible_content_types.purpose: Takes stands on beliefs you know the SA already shares; builds know-like-trust subconsciously and polarizes (both 'I like this person' and 'I don't' are desirable).

visible_content_types.name: Thought Reversal Content
visible_content_types.purpose: Positions you as a thought leader by challenging industry norms, limiting beliefs and objections; goes against the grain, attracting new people into the ecosystem.

visible_content_types.name: Educational Content
visible_content_types.rule: Must stem ONLY from your Unique Solution.

results.definition: The direct result you bring people — often their 'why', but not your purpose.
results.example: I am a copywriter and I help people make a bigger impact with powerful copy.

results_and_outcomes.deeper_purpose: The broader effect when everyone gets the promised result.

impact_goal.definition: A measurable internal metric, derived from the deeper purpose, that you monitor to know the purpose is being fulfilled.

content_template.note: Every visible content piece should have an eyeball-capturing title.

ecosystem_flow: Struggle Avatar → (Specifics, Common Enemy, content types) → Unique Solution → Future Paced Hero → Results → Deeper Purpose → Impact Goal
key_takeaways: Publish consistently across multiple content types rather than perfecting one piece.
Define the SA and FPH identities first; everything bridges between them.
Use hyper-specific language about the SA's pains and a common enemy.
Mix connection, thought-reversal and educational content.
Tie education strictly to your unique solution.
Distinguish results (what clients get) from deeper purpose (the world-level change), and track purpose with a measurable impact goal.
